property_summary: For all inputs, the reference C allows SetMinSum(...) to set MinSum only before Initialized() has been called (i.e., SetMinSum succeeds and updates MinSum iff intitalized==false); the mutant inverts the guard so it only allows setting after initialization, thereby breaking that rule for inputs where SetMinSum is called before Initialized().
change_summary: Invert the initialization guard so SetMinSum only sets MinSum if already initialized (checks intitalized instead of forbidding it).
